subject.title: fix #95895: [Security]: GEMINI_API_KEY written as a plaintext literal in the generated systemd service unit

question: Should OpenClaw accept the narrowed policy that file-backs only Google/Gemini auth-profile env refs in generated systemd service environments while other auth-profile env refs stay on the existing inline path?
rationale: The patch is mechanically proven, but it changes where provider credentials are delivered for installed services and chooses a provider-specific allowlist; CI cannot decide that security and compatibility boundary.

options.title: Accept The Narrow File-Backed Policy
options.body: Merge this PR after current-head checks remain green if maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

options.title: Request A Generic Auth-Profile Policy
options.body: Ask for a revised PR if the desired contract is to route all safe auth-profile env refs through one common file-backed policy instead of a Google/Gemini allowlist.

options.title: Keep Auth-Profile Rendering Separate
options.body: Pause or close this PR if maintainers want the linked security issue limited to config SecretRefs and plan separate auth-profile work later.

recommendation.title: Accept The Narrow File-Backed Policy
recommendation.body: Merge this PR after current-head checks remain green if maintainers agree the existing EnvironmentFile contract is the right boundary for Google/Gemini auth-profile keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the current-main config SecretRef repair for the same issue and authored adjacent render-source work in that merged PR.
